summary: The filing is a Form 8-K by BMO 2026-C15 Mortgage Trust, a CMBS issuing entity, reporting entry into an underwriting agreement and certificate purchase agreement for the issuance and sale of public and private certificates backed by commercial mortgages. The public certificates have an aggregate principal of about $650.6 million, closing on or about August 31, 2026. This is a routine structured-finance offering, not a special situation. No terms like price per share or premium apply. What to watch is the successful closing of the securitization.
